audit.whatIsWrong: The chart itself is already correct and consistent across layers (Skill, Lucian, Lucian, Sion, Sion, Sion, Sion — matching the packet), but diff says FAVOURED, tone is the favoured-lane green, and breakdown.difficulty / report[14] say 'Favoured matchup — difficulty 4/10' on a lane where the chart hands Sion four stages and the win rate is 25%.
audit.why: A page cannot say FAVOURED and then give the opponent every stage from Level 4 onward. Within this same champion file the tone tokens map cleanly: #3ddc97 on FAVOURED (this page), #e8b84b on EVEN (ryze), #ff8b3d on HARD (shen).
audit.corrected: diff FAVOURED -> HARD, tone -> #ff8b3d, difficulty prose -> 'Hard matchup — difficulty 7/10', ratings raised. Chart rows left alone — they were right.

audit.why: Four spikes, correctly owned: Lvl 2-3 Lucian window, Lvl 6 R plus charged Q, 1st item tank spike, Late zombie passive. Matches the chart.

audit.whatIsWrong: Roar of the Slayer appears nowhere on this page, in either layer.
audit.why: Riot text: 'Sion fires a short range shockwave that damages and slows and reduces the Armor of the first enemy hit. If the shockwave hits a minion or monster, it will be knocked back, damaging, slowing, and reducing the Armor of all enemies that it passes through.' At 800 range on 12/11/10/9/8s it out-ranges Piercing Light (500) and every auto Lucian has, it slows the target he most needs to walk away, and it cuts the armour a squishy top laner is relying on. It also means standing behind your own minions is not safe — he knocks one through you. This is the single most important unstated interaction here.
audit.corrected: Written into report[5].t, dosFull[2].d, breakdown.cooldowns and phases[3].why.

audit.whatIsWrong: Decimating Smash is written throughout as 'Decimating Smash (Stun)', as if it always stuns.
audit.why: Riot text: 'If he charges for enough time, enemies hit by the swing will also be knocked up and stunned.' A short tap is damage and a slow only. The whole step-up decision is reading how long he has held it, not whether the button is up — and the existing 'break the channel or sidestep the slam' advice never says that.
audit.corrected: Charge dependency and the 10/9/8/7/6s cooldown written into dosFull[0].d and breakdown.cooldowns. I did not rename the focus label itself, since that string is used as the tracked-ability key across many fields.

audit.whatIsWrong: No anti-heal anywhere, against a champion whose passive heals him.
audit.why: Glory in Death: 'His attacks become very rapid, heal him, and deal bonus damage based on his target's maximum Health.' Both flagged missing interactions for this matchup are about this — chip damage does not close him out, and stacking raw resistances is the wrong answer against percent-max-health damage from the passive and Soul Furnace.
audit.corrected: Executioner's added to report[8].t; the percent-health point added to phases[6].why.

edits.after: Soul Furnace soaks your burst and then detonates, and Roar of the Slayer shreds your armour from 800 — the lane flips.

notes: The kit file gives Sion's R a 'terrain: creates terrain, blocks paths and dashes' flag, but Riot's own description says only that he charges, steers, deals damage and knocks up on collision — no terrain. Per the flag-vs-description rule I trusted the description and wrote nothing about terrain. Worth checking whether that flag misfires on other champions too. The packet defect 'never names any of Sion's abilities' was accurate for the full layer: Soul Furnace, Roar of the Slayer, Glory in Death and Unstoppable Onslaught now all appear there. The content layer already carried the level chart correctly — the only chart-side problem was the FAVOURED label sitting on top of it.
